responsibility: Implements the FreeBSD-specific Rust frontend target hook initializer by overriding TARGET_RUST_OS_INFO. It reports the Rust target metadata for FreeBSD targets—unix family, freebsd OS, unknown vendor, and empty environment—through rust_add_target_info, then instantiates targetrustm with that hook set. This file is the Rust-language companion to FreeBSD target configuration headers, concerned only with Rust cfg-style OS identity.
